title: AFP says it was the target of a cyberattack; AFP Forum platform isolated and temporarily inaccessible
geo_basis: AFP's dateline is Paris; the page does not name a headquarters city
summary: AFP said in an internal management message that it was the target of a cyberattack from 01:30 Paris time on Thursday 26 November. Its teams isolated the AFP Forum platform on detecting the intrusion. Novinky.cz reports the service was still down on Friday morning, with a maintenance notice and no restoration date. AFP says it has no information on who is responsible and is working with outside experts.
plain: The news agency AFP says it was hit by a cyberattack overnight and cut off its AFP Forum platform as a precaution. It says it does not know who is behind it.
exec: AFP took its AFP Forum client platform offline after an intrusion; AFP says it offered clients alternative ways to access its content.

evidence.quote: La AFP fue blanco de un ciberataque esta noche [del miércoles a jueves], a partir de la 01H30 [hora de París].

validation.note: Unitel (AFP wire, Spanish) and RIA Novosti (Russian) each state AFP's message that it was the target of a cyberattack from 01:30 Paris time and that AFP Forum was isolated; both relay AFP's own statement. Novinky.cz (Czech) also reports AFP's message and that the platform was still down on Friday 27 November.

review.note: exec said 'major news agency' (own description, not in sources); reworded to match summary. Title, 01:30 Paris time, isolation, no-attacker statement, experts checked against Unitel, RIA, Novinky
